description.value: Cornerstones is a provincially registered, adult-oriented bed and breakfast in the heart of Qualicum Beach, recognized by TripAdvisor as one of the top 1% of inns and B&Bs worldwide and one of the top 25 in Canada. The property offers three spacious suites with private en-suites, daily full breakfasts using locally sourced ingredients, and a guest lounge with a fireplace and kitchenette. Its central location gives cyclists immediate access to Qualicum Beach's downtown, beach, trail systems, and parks, with 24/7 keyless entry and concierge services including shuttle arrangements to ferry terminals.

address.value: 166 Harlech Road, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1G9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly confirms on-site bike storage arranged through staff at time of booking ('Cornerstones offers on-site storage for bikes, kayaks, golf clubs and other small items. Let us know what you need at the time of booking, so that we can arrange storage accordingly'), qualifying as staff-controlled storage. Wi-Fi is confirmed ('Secured WIFI is complimentary throughout the property'). The website does not mention laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash. Address on the /information/ subpage ('166 Harlech Road, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1G9') corroborates OSM; phone number matches.
concerns: Bike storage described as staff-arranged but security level (locked/enclosed) not explicitly stated — direct confirmation recommended.
Website states property is not suitable for people with limited mobility; access is via stairs only — relevant for some cyclists.
Minor formatting difference in phone number between OSM (+1 778 837-9016) and some website pages (778-837-9016) — functionally the same number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established adult-oriented B&B in Qualicum Beach with explicit on-site bike storage, full breakfast, 24/7 access, and concierge services — a strong fit for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
